crossRefs.note: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

translations.web: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
translations.bsb: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
translations.kjv: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
translations.asv: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part.
